news.title: New Blues captain Erin Cuthbert looks back on her career and move away from home
news.title_zh: 新蓝军队长艾琳·卡斯伯特回顾她的职业生涯并离开家
news.body_en: Almost ten years ago, new Chelsea captain Erin Cuthbert moved hundreds of miles away from her family and everything she had ever known. At 18 years old, that was a huge sacrifice. Cuthbert was a year-and-a-half into a university degree when she was offered the chance to come and play for the Blues, at a time when women’s football was nowhere near as high-profile as it is today. The heartbreak of leaving her family behind fueled her determination to make that sacrifice worthwhile.  Trophies, international caps and many plaudits have followed since Cuthbert made that life-changing decision, and her single-mindedness and commitment to the Blues ensured she was the ideal choice to be given the armband permanently. To fully understand what being the club captain might mean to Cuthbert, we must head back to the beginning of her story with Chelsea. ‘The move came about when I was offered to come down to trial,’ our new skipper explains. ‘We played against Chelsea in the Champions League with Glasgow City. I'd always dreamed of playing professionally, and I thought I'd blown it because the manager took me off. Then, a few weeks later, I was asked to come down and trial for three or four days. ‘I embraced the challenge. I obviously told my mum and dad, and they were absolutely buzzing about it, but I think they were a bit scared, too. I had my life sorted, so I was giving up a lot. And when you're 18, moving to the Big Smoke, as we call it, is a big move. ‘I had the trial, and I scored a really good goal. We played a boys' team in a game, and no one was passing me the ball. It was about earning respect, and once I made a few good moves and some good actions with the ball, they were more inclined to pass to me.’ Cuthbert tells the story of how she had an email offer from Chelsea by the time she had reached Heathrow airport to catch her return flight to Scotland. But there was a caveat. In a transfer window in which the Blues had signed some big names – Crystal Dunn, Ramona Bachmann and Maren Mjelde – head coach Emma Hayes made it clear that the youngster would be with the first team for training only, and any game time would be with the reserves. As it turned out, Cuthbert never played with the reserves. She did what she does best: knuckled down and earned the trust of the manager and her team-mates. It wasn’t all plain sailing for her, though; in fact, it was far from it. ‘I cried. I cried a lot,’ she recalls with a tear in her eye. ‘I remember going to a Jess Glynne concert with my sister. They played that song – Take Me Home. Actually, it still makes me a little bit emotional now. It made me bawl my eyes out, because I love it in Scotland. I loved living with my family. I loved the life I had. ‘When you give it all up to chase your dreams, it's tough. I knew that if anything ever went wrong, my mum and dad were always waiting for me with open arms. I also knew that leaving had a profound effect on both of them. And that's also hard as a young girl, knowing that, yes, that's where they want you to go, but it absolutely broke their hearts as well. ‘That hurt me and made me more driven to be like, "Let's make this worthwhile. I'm going to do the best I can to achieve something."' After moving to London, Cuthbert shared a house with team-mates Beth England, Hannah Blundell and Ji So-yun. She recalls the ‘havoc’ they caused and the fun times they shared. And she credits Fran Kirby with teaching her to cook, something Cuthbert – and her parents – thank the former Blues forward for to this day. Her gratitude also extends to the Chelsea fans, who she says also played a huge role in helping her feel settled after her big move from Scotland. ‘The fans made a song for me pretty early,’ she recounts. ‘I remember making my debut at Wheatsheaf Park - it feels so long ago. I wasn’t anywhere near the level of the other superstars we had in the team. I was just Erin, and they welcomed me with open arms. ‘When people want you to do well, they're cheering you on, and they've got your back, you're more likely to relax and settle. I didn't have my mum and dad at the games. You instinctively look for your family in the crowd, and it's sad when they’re not there. When you have the fans cheering your name, it distracts you a little bit and takes you away from that sad feeling. 'I almost felt like my mum and dad were there because I was always getting my name cheered. Chelsea has always been a family to me. It has always been my home away from home. There are certain places where you feel you belong. Chelsea is that for me.’ Now, ten years on, ‘just Erin’ is the Chelsea captain. She gives us some insight into how she found out she had been given the armband permanently. 'Sonia took me to her office,' Cuthbert says. 'She said I was going to be the captain of the club. She asked me if I accepted, so I said, “Of course I accept it!” ‘We knew there was a process where we all, as players, had an input on who we felt was good to lead in different areas and in different ways. So the players had an input, and I believe the coaches were involved as well. ‘It’s nice that the process was thorough, and to come out of that as captain is obviously a nice compliment to be rated and valued by your own team-mates. It didn’t feel real, to be honest. I definitely was surprised by it.' Erin’s family are always supporting her, whether that’s from afar in Scotland or in person when they can come to the games. Our new captain explained in her typically expressive style how they received the news. ‘My mum has not stopped calling me captain on the phone,’ she laughs. ‘When I call her, the first thing she says when she answers the phone is not hello, it’s “Hello, captain!” So she’s taking the mickey a little bit, but I like that. And my dad’s just very much the same in terms of his emotion. He’s just like, “That’s great,” in a very monotone way, but I know he’s very proud of me, and that’s his way of expressing it.’ It feels like there is fresh energy at Chelsea. New players, new staff, and a new place to call home at Stamford Bridge. And for those who have never been to see us play, our new captain offers a passionate response as to why they should give it a try. ‘If you’ve never been to one of our games before, I guarantee that when you do come, you’ll come again,’ Cuthbert says. ‘I know what it feels like to sit on the terraces and cheer for your team: it’s addictive, you get hooked, you get drawn to the camaraderie and the fandom. ‘There’s no better feeling than celebrating a goal scored by your team – even with a stranger! That’s just the power of football. Even if you come alone, you’re never truly alone in our stadium.’ There’s no one better to tell new fans what it’s like at Chelsea than our new skipper Erin Cuthbert. She’s been with us since almost the beginning, and now she’s here to lead us into a bold new era.
news.body_zh: 大约十年前，新任切尔西队长艾琳·卡斯伯特搬到了远离家人和她所熟悉的一切的地方。 18岁那年，这是一个巨大的牺牲。当库斯伯特获得大学学位一年半时，她有机会为蓝军效力，当时女子足球远没有今天那么引人注目。离开家人的心碎促使她决心让这种牺牲值得。自从库斯伯特做出改变人生的决定以来，奖杯、国家队出场和许多赞誉接踵而至，她的一心一意和对蓝军的承诺确保了她成为永久获得队长袖标的理想选择。为了充分理解担任俱乐部队长对库斯伯特意味着什么，我们必须回到她与切尔西故事的开头。 “当我被邀请接受审判时，这一举动就发生了，”我们的新队长解释道。 “我们在冠军联赛中与格拉斯哥城队对阵切尔西队。我一直梦想成为职业球员，但我以为我的梦想已经泡汤了，因为主教练把我解雇了。然后，几周后，我被要求下来试用三四天。 “我接受了这个挑战。我显然告诉了我的妈妈和爸爸，他们对此议论纷纷，但我认为他们也有点害怕。我的生活已经安排好了，所以我放弃了很多。当你 18 岁的时候，搬到我们所说的 Big Smoke 是一个重大的举动。 “我参加了试训，并且打进了一个非常好的进球。我们和男孩队进行了一场比赛，没有人传球给我。这是为了赢得尊重，一旦我做出了一些好的动作和一些带球的好动作，他们就更倾向于把球传给我。”卡斯伯特讲述了当她到达希思罗机场搭乘返回苏格兰的航班时，她如何收到切尔西的电子邮件邀请的故事。但有一个警告。在蓝军签下一些大牌球员——克里斯特尔·邓恩、雷蒙娜·巴赫曼和马伦·米耶德——的转会窗口中，主教练艾玛·海耶斯明确表示，这名年轻球员只会在一线队进行训练，任何比赛时间都将在预备队中。事实证明，卡斯伯特从未在预备队打过球。她做了她最擅长的事情：努力工作并赢得了主教练和队友的信任。但对她来说，这并非一帆风顺。事实上，事实远非如此。 ’我哭了。我哭了很多次，”她眼含泪水回忆道。 “我记得和姐姐一起去听 Jess Glynne 的音乐会。他们演奏了那首歌——带我回家。其实现在想起来还是有点感触的。这让我痛哭流涕，因为我喜欢苏格兰。我喜欢和家人住在一起。我热爱我的生活。 “当你放弃一切去追逐你的梦想时，这很艰难。我知道，如果发生任何问题，我的妈妈和爸爸总是张开双臂等着我。我也知道离开对他们俩都有深远的影响。作为一个年轻女孩，这也很困难，因为知道，是的，那就是他们希望你去的地方，但这也绝对让他们心碎。 “这伤害了我，让我更有动力说，‘让我们让这一切变得有价值。我会尽我所能去实现一些目标。’”搬到伦敦后，卡斯伯特与队友贝丝·英格兰、汉娜·布伦德尔和季素妍合住了一所房子。她回忆起他们造成的“破坏”以及他们分享的欢乐时光。她认为弗兰·柯比教她做饭，库斯伯特和她的父母至今仍感谢这位前蓝军前锋。她还对切尔西球迷表示感谢，她说切尔西球迷在帮助她从苏格兰转会到安定下来方面发挥了巨大作用。 “粉丝们很早就为我创作了一首歌，”她回忆道。 “我记得在惠特谢夫公园首次亮相——感觉是很久以前的事了。我的水平远不及我们队中其他超级巨星的水平。我只是艾琳，他们张开双臂欢迎我。 “当人们希望你表现出色时，他们会为你加油，他们会支持你，你就更有可能放松下来并安定下来。我没有爸爸妈妈参加比赛。你本能地在人群中寻找你的家人，当他们不在时，你会感到悲伤。当粉丝们为你的名字欢呼时，它会分散你的注意力，让你远离悲伤的感觉。 “我几乎感觉我的妈妈和爸爸就在那里，因为我的名字总是得到欢呼。切尔西对我来说一直都是一个家。它一直是我的家外之家。 有些地方让你感觉自己有归属感。切尔西对我来说就是这样。”十年过去了，“只有艾琳”成为了切尔西队长。她让我们了解了她是如何发现自己被永久授予臂章的。 “索尼娅带我去她的办公室，”卡斯伯特说。 “她说我将成为俱乐部的队长。她问我是否接受，我说：当然接受！ “我们知道有一个过程，作为球员，我们所有人都会对我们认为谁适合以不同方式领导不同领域提出意见。所以球员们有意见，我相信教练们也参与其中。 “很高兴这个过程很彻底，作为队长显然是一个很好的赞美，可以得到你自己的队友的评价和重视。说实话，感觉不太真实。我确实对此感到惊讶。艾琳的家人总是支持她，无论是远道而来的苏格兰，还是亲自到场观看比赛。我们的新船长以她典型的表达方式解释了他们是如何收到这个消息的。 “我妈妈一直在电话里叫我队长，”她笑着说。 “当我给她打电话时，她接电话时说的第一句话不是你好，而是‘你好，队长！’”所以她有点像米奇，但我喜欢这样。我父亲的情绪也非常相似。他只是以一种非常单调的方式说：“太棒了”，但我知道他为我感到非常自豪，这就是他表达这一点的方式。’感觉切尔西充满了新鲜的活力。新球员、新员工以及斯坦福桥的新家。对于那些从未看过我们比赛的人，我们的新队长热情地回答了为什么他们应该尝试一下。 “如果你以前从未看过我们的一场比赛，我保证当你来的时候，你会再来的，”卡斯伯特说。 “我知道坐在看台上为你的球队加油的感觉：这让人上瘾，你会着迷，你会被友情和球迷所吸引。 “没有什么比庆祝你的球队进球更好的感觉了——即使是和一个陌生人一起庆祝！”这就是足球的力量。即使你一个人来，在我们的体育场里你也永远不会真正孤单。”没有人比我们的新队长艾琳·库斯伯特更适合告诉新球迷切尔西的感觉了。她几乎从一开始就和我们在一起，现在她将带领我们进入一个大胆的新时代。

news.body_en: The dates and kick-off times for Chelsea Women's home fixture against Tottenham, as well as our away trips to West Ham, Crystal Palace and Charlton, have now been confirmed. Our first match of the month is away at West Ham on Sunday 4 October. Sky Sports are the broadcaster for that fixture, and it will kick off at 2pm at the Chigwell Construction Stadium in Dagenham. Tickets for this match will go on sale at 10am on Tuesday 8 September. The month of October sees us play just once at home in the Women's Super League, with all of our league matches now hosted at Stamford Bridge. That fixture, against Tottenham, has now been confirmed to be broadcast by Sky Sports on Sunday 18 October. The match will kick off at 12 noon. Tickets for our home game against Spurs are on sale now. If you fancy experiencing our Bottomless at the Bridge Hospitality package with a full buffet and free-flowing drinks, click here to find out more. After facing Spurs at the Bridge, we will next travel to newly-promoted Crystal Palace on Sunday 25 October at 12 noon. The match at Borough Sports Ground in Sutton will also be shown on Sky Sports. Our first league game in November takes us to another newly-promoted WSL side. We will head to The Valley to face Charlton Athletic on Sunday 1 November for a 2.30pm kick-off, and this match will be shown live on BBC Two. news.title: Chelsea Diary: Chances to bounce back
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：反弹的机会
news.body_en: Here is everything to look out for at Chelsea in the coming week, as knockout football returns ahead of a busy weekend, with three games in one day. We begin the week with some reflection, as Xabi Alonso calls on his team to learn some important lessons from Sunday's defeat away at Arsenal. Those sentiments are echoed by Morgan Rogers, Maxence Lacroix and skipper Reece James, as we bring you all the reaction to the derby at the Emirates Stadium, as well as highlights and the full match replay. You can also get Sonia Bompastor's reaction after Chelsea Women were held to a 1-1 draw by Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge in our first Women's Super League fixture of the season, as well as catching up on the action with our highlights and full match replay. In addition, Aggie Beever-Jones reflects on making her 100th appearance for the Blues against the Birmingham side. After preparing his team on the training pitch, Alonso will be sitting down with the media at Cobham to preview Chelsea's Carabao Cup third round tie against Leeds United. You can watch our manager's pre-match press conference live on the Chelsea Official App and website at 1.30pm, or catch up on demand later in the day. Midweek knockout football is back on the agenda for the Blues on Wednesday evening, as Leeds come to Stamford Bridge in the third round of this season's Carabao Cup. Having defeated Luton Town on home soil in the previous round, Chelsea are hoping to continue our progress in the competition and put Sunday's loss at Arsenal behind us. Kick-off in SW6 is at 8pm and supporters in the UK can watch the game live on Sky Sports. We will also be providing updates throughout the day and the game itself in our Chelsea vs Leeds United Match Centre. Highlights and the full match replay of Wednesday night's Carabao Cup match against Leeds will both be available to watch on the Chelsea Official App and website from 1am on Thursday. That is alongside all the post-match reaction from Alonso and his players. Attention will already be shifting ahead to the coming weekend's action on Thursday, though, with Chelsea Women coming to the fore in the afternoon. That is when Bompastor will be holding her pre-match press conference at Cobham ahead of Sunday's Women's Super League visit to Manchester United. You can watch it live on the Chelsea Official App and website at 3pm, or catch up in full on demand afterwards. A quick turnaround for our men's team means Alonso will be back at his press conference desk in Cobham on Friday, this time looking ahead to the weekend's Premier League fixture against Hull City. As always, you can see it live on the Chelsea Official App and website, or watch it back in full later in the day. We will also take you behind the scenes at Cobham, with an exclusive look at Chelsea's final training session before facing Hull, to see how Alonso has been preparing his team for Saturday's Premier League fixture against the Tigers. There is live football for you to enjoy as Chelsea Under-18s kick-off a busy day of action for the club. The young Blues travel away to Brighton & Hove Albion in the Under-18 Premier League hoping to bounce back from last week's loss at Fulham and rediscover the form that had seen us win three in a row before that fixture. The game begins at 11am and CFC+ subscribers can watch it live in our Brighton & Hove Albion vs Chelsea Under-18s Match Centre. The full 90 minutes will also be available to watch back for CFC+ subscribers after the game. Before the men take to the pitch at the Bridge, Cobham Next Gen are in action on Saturday afternoon. news.title: Reece James: It’s a small bump in the road but we’ll be back
news.title_zh: 里斯·詹姆斯：这是路上的一个小坎坷，但我们会回来的
news.body_en: Reece James was disappointed with the outcome of our game at Arsenal on Sunday but doesn’t think it should overshadow what has been a promising start to the Xabi Alonso era at Chelsea. At the end of a fiercely contested derby that was in the balance throughout, the Blues had tasted defeat for the first time this season. We succumbed 2-1 to the champions in north London despite a fine early Morgan Rogers strike. For our skipper, the game hinged on fine margins and there are aspects of our performance that pleased him, with other areas to improve upon. ‘We didn’t get the result we wanted and we are not happy about that, but there were positives,’ James said. ‘We started the game really well. Even when we went behind, we showed character to try and get back in the game. We ran out of time in the end. ‘Football at this level is a game of moments. It’s one or two things that change the scoreline, and that gets overplayed a bit. ‘It was a tough game and we have to review and take the learnings. We have another game against Leeds in a few days and we have to get ready for that.’ The forthcoming fixtures against Leeds – in the Carabao Cup third round – and then Hull City provide an opportunity for the Blues to respond to our maiden setback of the season. James says there is a good mood around the camp, and that life under Alonso has been a period of education and tangible progress. He feels it bodes well for the season ahead. ‘It’s been two months working with the new manager and his staff and we’re enjoying it so far,’ explained James. ‘We try and adapt as fast as possible. We’re still getting to know him and the way he wants us to play, and that comes with time. We’re dedicated to what he wants and the way he wants us to play. ‘We’ve had two wins from three in the league. It’s a small bump in the road but we’ll be back. We have to focus on ourselves and not let other teams distract us. ‘It’s gameweek three; we have 35 more to go. With time, patience and hard work we will be in and around it.’
news.body_zh: 里斯·詹姆斯对周日对阵阿森纳的比赛结果感到失望，但他认为这不应掩盖哈维·阿隆索时代在切尔西的美好开局。在这场竞争激烈、始终处于平衡状态的德比结束时，蓝军本赛季第一次尝到了失败的滋味。尽管摩根·罗杰斯早早进球，但我们还是在北伦敦以 2-1 输给了冠军球队。对于我们的队长来说，比赛取决于微弱的比分，我们的表现有一些方面令他满意，但还有其他方面需要改进。 “我们没有得到我们想要的结果，我们对此并不满意，但也有积极的一面，”詹姆斯说。 ‘我们的比赛开局非常好。即使我们落后了，我们也表现出了尝试重新回到比赛的性格。最后我们没时间了。 “这个级别的足球是一场充满瞬间的比赛。改变比分的是一两件事，而且有点被夸大了。 “这是一场艰难的比赛，我们必须回顾并吸取教训。几天后我们还有另一场对阵利兹联的比赛，我们必须为此做好准备。”即将到来的联赛杯第三轮对阵利兹联队以及赫尔城队的比赛为蓝军提供了应对本赛季首次失利的机会。詹姆斯说营地周围气氛很好，阿隆索领导下的生活是一段受教育和取得切实进步的时期。他认为这对未来的赛季来说是个好兆头。 “与新主帅和他的员工一起工作已经两个月了，到目前为止我们很享受，”詹姆斯解释道。 “我们尝试尽快适应。我们仍在了解他以及他希望我们打球的方式，而这需要时间。我们致力于他想要的以及他希望我们打球的方式。 ‘我们在联赛中取得了三场胜利中的两场。这是路上的一个小坎坷，但我们会回来的。我们必须专注于自己，不要让其他球队分散我们的注意力。 “这是第三周比赛；我们还有 35 个任务要完成。只要时间、耐心和努力，我们就会融入其中并围绕它。

news.title: Katie McCabe on developing the women's game with Chelsea and staying calm after Villa draw
news.title_zh: 凯蒂·麦凯布谈与切尔西一起发展女子比赛并在维拉抽签后保持冷静
news.body_en: After spending a decade at Arsenal, Chelsea summer signing Katie McCabe made her first WSL appearance as a Blue in our 1-1 draw against Aston Villa on Saturday. While the result wasn’t quite what we wanted, the Ireland skipper was keen to take the positives from what was a landmark moment for her at Stamford Bridge. A lifelong Blues fan, McCabe had strong reasons for making the switch this summer, and now fully embedded in life at Chelsea, she’s discovered that the club’s ambitions off the pitch match where she wants to go on the pitch. ‘I've been enjoying it,’ she said. ‘It's been a long pre-season. We've had the Women's Champions League qualifiers as well, and we're really pleased that we're into the league phase now. ‘Coming into a fantastic football club at Chelsea, they really want to push and develop the women's game as well. We’ve got such leaders in the team. You can see that with Lucy (Bronze) captaining us today, and we still have Erin (Cuthbert) to come back. ‘You can see how Keira (Walsh) dominates the ball, and LJ (Lauren James) wants to make things happen. There are different styles of play, different ways of playing, and I think I’m still getting used to it and adjusting to things a little bit. But I feel good, I feel confident, and I just want to try to keep going and take a step further every week.’ Chelsea made a rapid start against Aston Villa, breaking the deadlock through a skilled finish from James after 11 minutes. For all the intensity of our play, we couldn’t find a way to extend the lead, though, in part due to an exceptional performance and nine saves made by opposition goalkeeper Akane Okuma. Yet there is a long way to go after just one matchday. The WSL has expanded to 14 teams this season, meaning extra games and more opportunities to take all three points. McCabe was keen to put the result into perspective. ‘We started really well,’ she continued. ‘We wanted to start with a lot of energy and create some opportunities, which we did. But at this level, we need to be more clinical in front of goal and of course, we're frustrated to drop points at home. ‘But we're not going to panic; obviously, it's the start of the season. We’ll look to rectify it through the week. We're just disappointed because it's not Chelsea standards to drop points at home.’ Against Villa, McCabe put in a typically hard-working display with the most passes attempted in the final third of any player in the side (39), the most crosses delivered (ten), the joint-highest number of chances created (four), and the joint-most tackles made (two). ‘Sonia just wanted me to express my qualities on the ball,’ McCabe explained. ‘To try to get Alyssa (Thompson) on it, LJ in the pocket as well, Keira… players that can really make things happen and to make sure we were obviously keeping compact defensively as well. Unfortunately, we conceded a very sloppy goal, which we're disappointed with. ‘Being at Stamford Bridge now in the WSL, playing all our home games here, we wanted to start off on the right foot, but like I said, the message is not to panic. There's a long way to go. The league is getting more competitive as we've seen. Villa did well to defend for most of the game and come away with a point, so I have to give it to them as well. ‘We really wanted to suffocate them in the first half. We knew we'd get them to defend deep and defend the box. It felt like it was a bit slow in the second half. The ball wasn't really in play a lot. We were trying to get the ball going. ‘But it's up to us to bring the intensity in those moments, and I think the girls did really well in the wide areas with some intricate passes and some crossing opportunities as well. We have to be getting on the end of them in the box and putting them away. ‘We have a big week ahead now and a big game away at Man United, which is not easy. They'll be wanting to put things right after their result as well. We need full focus on next week.’
news.body_zh: 在阿森纳效力十年后，切尔西夏季签约球员凯蒂·麦凯布在周六 1-1 战平阿斯顿维拉的比赛中首次代表蓝军出场。虽然结果并不完全是我们想要的，但这位爱尔兰队长渴望从她在斯坦福桥的里程碑时刻中汲取积极的一面。作为一名终生的蓝军球迷，麦凯布有充分的理由在今年夏天做出转变，现在她已经完全融入了切尔西的生活，她发现俱乐部在球场外的雄心壮志与她想要在球场上的表现相匹配。 “我一直很享受，”她说。 ‘这是一个漫长的季前备战。我们还进行了女子冠军联赛预选赛，我们很高兴现在进入了联赛阶段。 “来到切尔西这样一家出色的足球俱乐部，她们也真的想推动和发展女子足球比赛。我们的团队中有这样的领导者。你可以看到，今天露西（青铜）担任我们的队长，我们还有艾琳（卡斯伯特）回来。 “你可以看到凯拉（沃尔什）如何主宰球，而 LJ（劳伦·詹姆斯）希望让事情发生。有不同的比赛风格，不同的比赛方式，我想我还在适应它并进行一些调整。但我感觉很好，我很有信心，我只是想继续前进，每周都更进一步。”切尔西在对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中迅速开局，11分钟后詹姆斯的精彩射门打破了僵局。尽管我们的比赛强度很大，但我们还是找不到扩大领先优势的方法，部分原因是出色的表现和对手门将奥隈茜的九次扑救。然而，仅仅一场比赛之后，还有很长的路要走。 WSL本赛季已扩大到14支球队，这意味着有更多的比赛和更多的机会全取三分。麦凯布热衷于正确看待这一结果。 “我们的起步非常好，”她继续说道。 “我们希望从大量精力开始并创造一些机会，我们做到了。但在这个层面上，我们需要在进球前更加冷静，当然，我们对在主场丢分感到沮丧。 “但我们不会惊慌；显然，这是赛季的开始。我们将在本周内努力纠正这一问题。我们只是感到失望，因为在主场丢分不是切尔西的标准。”对阵维拉的比赛中，麦凯布表现出了典型的勤奋表现，在球队最后三分之一的球员中，麦凯布的传球次数最多（39次），传中次数最多（10次），创造的机会次数并列最高（4次），铲断次数并列最多（2次）。 “索尼娅只是想让我在球上表现出我的品质，”麦凯布解释道。 “为了让阿莉莎（汤普森）上场，还有LJ在口袋里，凯拉……那些真正能够让事情发生的球员，并确保我们在防守上也明显保持紧凑。不幸的是，我们丢了一个非常草率的进球，我们对此感到失望。 “现在在斯坦福桥参加WSL，我们所有的主场比赛都在这里进行，我们希望以正确的方式开始，但就像我说的，我们传达的信息是不要惊慌。还有很长的路要走。正如我们所看到的，联盟的竞争变得越来越激烈。维拉在比赛的大部分时间里防守都做得很好，并拿下一分，所以我也必须把它送给他们。 “我们真的很想在上半场让他们窒息。我们知道我们会让他们深入防守并防守禁区。感觉下半场有点慢。球并没有真正发挥很多作用。我们试图让球继续前进。 “但我们要在这些时刻发挥强度，我认为女孩们在边路表现得非常好，有一些复杂的传球和传中机会。我们必须把它们放进盒子里，然后把它们收起来。 “我们现在还有重要的一周，还有客场对阵曼联的一场重要比赛，这并不容易。他们也会希望在结果出来后把事情做好。我们需要全神贯注于下周。

news.title: Lacroix: We want to learn from this
news.title_zh: 拉克鲁瓦：我们想从中学习
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix admits Chelsea’s narrow defeat at Arsenal was a painful result for the players, but insists they are eager to take lessons on board from the game to come back stronger. The Blues made a flying start to the game as we raced into an early lead through Morgan Rogers’ second goal of the season, but eventually the Premier League champions made their home advantage tell, scoring either side of half-time to inflict our first defeat under Xabi Alonso. We came close to salvaging a draw at the Emirates Stadium, with Pedro Neto hitting the post and Estevao Willian being denied by a fingertip save late on, but eventually travelled back across London without a point to show for our efforts. ‘We are a little bit unhappy, of course, after losing, but I believe that we did well to be honest,’ said Lacroix. ‘We just have to adjust some points. I think it’s not easy to play there but we did good. ‘We accept the loss but we want to learn from it. I think it’s good to learn about the mistakes and all the wrong parts. We have to go forward and go again.’ Our French defender was doubly disappointed as he felt our performance deserved more than we got, after showing that we were capable of taking the game to the title holders on their own turf. ‘I think it was a good start but once they scored it got more and more difficult. But we showed that we also had good actions and good attacks, so the defeat hurts a little bit. We gave our best. ‘I think we deserved more. Luck was not by our side, but we have to accept it. The desire to score, the attitude was clear. We showed good character until the very end. We deserved the 2-2, but we learned for next time.’ Lacroix and his fellow Blues don’t have to wait long for the chance to put that loss behind them, with a busy week ahead. That starts with a Carabao Cup third-round tie against Leeds United at Stamford Bridge on Wednesday evening, before we host Hull City in the Premier League on Saturday afternoon.
news.body_zh: 马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦承认切尔西以微弱优势输给阿森纳对球员来说是一个痛苦的结果，但他坚称他们渴望从比赛中吸取教训，以便以更强的实力回归。蓝军在比赛中取得了良好的开局，摩根·罗杰斯本赛季的第二个进球让我们早早取得领先，但最终英超冠军凭借主场优势，在半场左右各进一球，给我们在哈维·阿隆索的带领下首次失利。我们差点在酋长球场挽回一场平局，佩德罗·内托击中门柱，埃斯特沃·威廉在最后时刻被指尖扑救挡出，但最终回到伦敦，我们的努力没有取得一分。 “当然，输球后我们有点不高兴，但说实话，我相信我们做得很好，”拉克鲁瓦说。 ‘我们只需要调整一些点。我认为在那里踢球并不容易，但我们做得很好。 “我们接受损失，但我们想从中吸取教训。我认为了解错误和所有错误的部分是件好事。我们必须前进，再前进。”我们的法国后卫感到双重失望，因为在证明我们有能力在自己的地盘上将比赛带到卫冕冠军之后，他认为我们的表现值得更多。 “我认为这是一个良好的开端，但一旦他们进球，事情就变得越来越困难。但我们表现出了良好的行动和进攻，所以失败有点让人伤心。我们竭尽全力。 “我认为我们应该得到更多。运气没有站在我们这边，但我们必须接受它。进球的欲望、态度都很明确。直到最后我们都表现出了良好的品格。 2-2 是我们应得的，但我们为下一次吸取了教训。” 拉克鲁瓦和他的蓝军队友很快就有机会将这场失利抛诸脑后，接下来的一周将是忙碌的。首先是周三晚上在斯坦福桥对阵利兹联的卡拉宝杯第三轮比赛，然后是周六下午在英超联赛中迎战赫尔城。

news.title: From the archive: Marcel Desailly on building a winning mentality at Chelsea
news.title_zh: 档案摘录：马塞尔·德塞利谈在切尔西建立获胜心态
news.body_en: Marcel Desailly celebrates his 58th birthday today, and in an interview first published in the matchday programme, the French great tells us how he recovered from a baptism of fire to become a legendary Chelsea skipper… 'I had to face the reality of the Premier League, the fighting spirit.' Marcel Desailly still remembers his Chelsea debut vividly, 27 years later. He had arrived in England as a World Cup winner, a Champions League winner, a world-class player who had bestrode European football, first with Marseille and then as part of a dominant AC Milan side in the mid-1990s. A centre-back in his early days, the France international had recreated himself as a midfield demolition man in Italy – he was even depicted volleying a wrecking ball through a wall in an advert for his preferred football boots. At Chelsea, he was set to revert to his original role at the heart of the defence, alongside his compatriot, Frank Leboeuf. Rarely has a central defensive partnership been so eagerly anticipated at the start of a season, and yet when the curtain rose on the 1998/99 Premier League campaign, the indomitable Desailly found himself enduring the archetypal welcome to English football. ‘For the first match I came to Coventry and a smaller stadium,’ he recalls, ‘where I didn’t know too much about the quality of the opponent, which was Dion Dublin. 'At the time, with the crowd very close to the players, it was something different – another world, another world – coming from San Siro. Oh, it was very, very difficult because I came full of confidence. I was coming from AC Milan, I was a World Cup winner.’ Dublin put the hammer down on his marker that August afternoon at Highfield Road, battling and bruising, all limbs as he rose first to each cross, flicking the ball on to his pacey strike partner, Darren Huckerby. The home fans chanted ‘Eng-er-land, Eng-er-land, En-ger-land!’ as Gianluca Vialli’s cosmopolitan Blues toiled in the face of an old-fashioned barrage of balls into the box. We fell to a 2-1 defeat and the media narrative was clear. ‘Glamour boys fall to scrap dealers,’ was the headline in The Independent the next morning. But Vialli’s mantra was ‘You win or you learn’ and his new signing bore those words out in the weeks, months and seasons that followed. Desailly took notes that day, and went on to become a towering figure in a team that went 21 league games unbeaten following that opening day humbling at Coventry. He was the basis of a new way of defending – solid, yes, but smart and technically gifted too. He was nicknamed The Rock, but there was a cleanness to his work that made his defending incredibly watchable. ‘Anticipation, yeah,’ he says, when this is put to him. ‘Anticipation of the pass to your opponents. Yeah, that was probably one of my strengths, my capabilities. ‘Even though I was 29, 30 years old, I really wanted to face that challenge and the pride of being a defender. I’d been so frustrated in the years before I reached England. As a midfielder, you don’t feel the reward when you grab the ball from the opponent or a nice clean tackle. So this was important for me to experience in England, where you get rewarded for the nice tackle. ‘It was a good era where strikers were in numbers, the diversity was quite high on how you had to position yourself and, again, the intensity of the match every time. ‘But the key thing for us Chelsea players – for that generation, I mean – was that we built a foundation of possession. We were having the possession. Only Graeme Le Saux, when he was getting the ball on the left side, was tempted to kick the ball as a typical English player, which was okay for us. 'But yes, we started with the possession because you had [Gustavo] Poyet, you had Dan Petrescu, you had Gianfranco Zola, the magician. We’re really proud that we suddenly started to bring something different, building the winning mentality at Chelsea through possession and not through the typical English way of playing.’ In Desailly’s first season here, Chelsea only lost three games – the same as champions Manchester United – but we drew too many and finished four points behind Sir Alex Ferguson’s side, with Arsenal sandwiched between us. ‘Unfortunately, it took time,’ says Desailly, who now works as a TV pundit for beIN Sports and as an ambassador for various organisations. ‘We were in a position where, at home, we were really capable of winning and taking the match on. But away, with the type of possession that we were trying to have… impossible. ‘We lost so many points away, because we were a different type of player, you see. So we had a problem. We didn’t really know how to play counter-attack, compared to Manchester United and Arsenal, who were set up to match the reality of English football at that time. We were a bit ahead of the time.’ It’s a point worth dwelling on for a moment. While United and Arsenal played the kind of high-tempo counterattacking game that characterised English football at the turn of the century, Chelsea’s managers craved control and possession – a style of play more associated with the Premier League in the 2020s. ‘Don’t throw the ball away’ is the phrase Desailly associates with his time here, first under Vialli and then Claudio Ranieri. However, towards the end of his Blues career here he began to see a different Chelsea emerging, one that was ready to challenge for the title more seriously. ‘In 2004, if Arsenal did not do the invincible season, we were going to win it,’ he says, ‘because the quality of the players was very high, with Veron, Crespo, Makelele, Geremi... John Terry was starting to be at his peak, and Lampard was also at his peak. ‘Well done to Ranieri. He identified Lampard at West Ham. At the beginning, we didn’t understand really because he didn’t train very well. He’s smart, you know, to minimise his effort at the training, but at the matches, wow, what a smart midfielder! 'And as for John, we knew that he was a leader, naturally. From the beginning, I saw him: young, fresh, English… ready, coming to train with short sleeves and shorts when it was minus four, minus five! ‘But I want to say that we are proud to have built the foundation. I say it again, the winning mentality of Chelsea started from us with a bit of luck of having [Roman] Abramovich coming into the system after Ken Bates decided to sell the club. “That Liverpool match… I know you want to talk about it.” He’s not wrong. Who wouldn’t want to talk to Marcel Desailly about the final game of the 2002/03 campaign, when we met Liverpool knowing that a win or a draw would see us return to the Champions League, while defeat would allow our opponents to take the final spot in that competition? More than that, there was much talk of the club’s dire financial situation ahead of that game, and the need to qualify for the biggest European competition to bag the prize money that would help to sustain our status as a top club. ‘Yes, yes, yes, financially it was not that good,’ says Desailly, ‘They were about to... yeah, it was difficult. Difficult. So yeah, I could feel it was unique. Okay, it was also unique to play matches against Milan, against Barcelona, in the Champions League, but that particular Liverpool Premier League match was really under tension.’ We fell behind early that day, but Desailly – wearing the captain’s armband – dragged us back into the game with a headed equaliser, shortly before Jesper Gronkjaer scored what turned out to be the winner in a dramatic first half. I ask how it felt to score that crucial goal in our history. ‘Responsibility as a captain, you know?’ he says. ‘We were 1-0 down. I can’t really explain why I was there – the corner was not being played and there was no reason for me to be there! ‘Responsibility. Let me try something, let me go forward and show my team-mates what I’m capable of, and of course it helped that, after, Gronkjaer did his own one! ‘Yeah, we were very pleased, very pleased. When you see the evolution of Chelsea over the years afterwards… I had to leave [a year later] because I was 35, or something like that. I couldn’t stay. I still had one more year left, and I went and experienced the Middle East vibe of football, but with an eye on Chelsea… and in fact, they won the league. The year I left, they won the league!” Desailly did win the FA Cup in 2000 – the last final at the original Wembley – but it doesn’t seem fair that, after captaining that squad to the verge of greatness, he missed out on the club’s first league title in 50 years. ‘Yeah, it’s not fair,’ he agrees. ‘It happened with Milan also, but that was different because I had won it already with them. With Chelsea it was a mix of happiness and pain.’ Regardless, his legendary status is secure at Stamford Bridge, where he is one of the iconic players celebrated with a permanent display on the original Shed Wall. On the list of Chelsea captains, his name sits comfortably between Dennis Wise and John Terry, and he brought his own way of doing things to the role. ‘It was a long time Dennis was our captain, and he was an historic player, with a pitbull mentality, so we were following him, we were ready to die for him,’ says Desailly. ‘I was a captain in a different way, trying to be available for everyone through my experience of the highest level. I was very proud to hold the captaincy at Chelsea, I tell you. Wow, wow, wow. ‘I wanted something different, and I’m very pleased that I made the move [to Chelsea]. Even though I was playing at Milan, it was really a good move for me football-wise, lifestyle-wise. It was important for my kids to be able to experience it. Even now, my kids thank me that they’ve made connections at the French school, to be expatriated in so dynamic a country as England. And to be part of raising the level of what is now the Premier League was something great – yes, yes.’ This interview was first published in the matchday programme. news.body_zh: 马塞尔·德塞利今天庆祝了他的 58 岁生日，在比赛日节目中首次发表的采访中，这位法国伟人向我们讲述了他如何从战火的洗礼中恢复过来，成为一名传奇的切尔西队长……“我必须面对英超联赛的现实，即战斗精神。” 27 年后，马塞尔·德塞利仍然清晰地记得他在切尔西的首秀。他以世界杯冠军、欧冠冠军、世界级球员的身份来到英格兰，他先是在马赛效力，然后在 20 世纪 90 年代中期效力于占据统治地位的 AC 米兰队。这位法国国脚早年是一名中后卫，后来在意大利将自己塑造成一名中场破坏者——甚至在他最喜欢的足球鞋广告中，他被描绘成将破坏球凌空射穿墙壁。在切尔西，他将恢复原来的防守核心角色，与他的同胞弗兰克·勒博夫并肩作战。很少有中卫搭档在赛季开始时如此受到如此热切的期待，然而当 1998/99 赛季英超联赛拉开帷幕时，不屈不挠的德塞利发现自己受到了英格兰足球的典型欢迎。 “第一场比赛我来到了考文垂，这是一个较小的体育场，”他回忆道，“在那里我对对手的实力不太了解，对手是迪昂·都柏林。 “当时，人群离球员非常近，从圣西罗传来的是不同的东西——另一个世界，另一个世界。噢，非常非常困难，因为我充满了信心。那个八月的下午，都柏林在海菲尔德路球场将球锤敲在了自己的记号笔上，他在每一次传中中都奋力拼搏，四肢受伤，每次传中时他都奋力将球传给了他的速度很快的锋线搭档达伦·哈克比。当吉安卢卡·维亚利 (Gianluca Vialli) 的国际化蓝军面对着进入禁区的老式球门时，主场球迷高呼“英格兰国、英格兰国、英格兰国！”。我们以 2-1 落败，媒体的报道很清楚。第二天早上，《独立报》的头条新闻是“魅力男孩落入废品经销商手中”。但维亚利的座右铭是“要么赢，要么学习”，他的新援在接下来的几周、几个月和几个赛季中都印证了这句话。德塞利那天做了笔记，并在揭幕战对阵考文垂之后，成为球队中的佼佼者，球队在联赛中保持了 21 场不败。他是新防守方式的基础——是的，他很扎实，但也很聪明，技术上也很有天赋。他被昵称为“岩石”，但他的工作干净利落，这使得他的防守非常引人注目。当这个问题摆在他面前时，他说道：“是的，期待。” “对传给对手的预期。是的，这可能是我的优势、我的能力之一。 “尽管我已经 29 岁、30 岁了，但我真的很想面对挑战，并为作为一名后卫感到自豪。在我到达英国之前的几年里，我一直非常沮丧。作为一名中场球员，当你从对手手中抢到球或者一次干净利落的铲球时，你不会感受到奖励。所以这对我在英格兰的经历很重要，在那里你会因为漂亮的铲球而得到奖励。 “那是一个美好的时代，前锋数量众多，在如何定位自己以及每次比赛的强度方面都存在很大的多样性。 “但对我们切尔西球员来说——我的意思是那一代人——最重要的是我们建立了控球基础。我们拥有财产。只有格雷姆·勒索克斯（Graeme Le Sa​​ux）在左侧拿到球时，像典型的英国球员一样想踢球，这对我们来说没问题。 “但是，是的，我们从控球开始，因为你有[古斯塔沃]波耶特，你有丹·佩特雷斯库，你有魔术师吉安弗兰科·佐拉。我们真的很自豪我们突然开始带来一些不同的东西，通过控球而不是通过典型的英国比赛方式在切尔西建立获胜心态。”德塞利在这里的第一个赛季，切尔西只输了三场比赛——与冠军曼联一样——但我们平局太多，最终落后弗格森爵士的球队四分，阿森纳夹在我们中间。 “不幸的是，这需要时间，”德塞利说道，他现在担任 beIN Sports 的电视评论员，并担任多个组织的大使。 “在主场，我们确实有能力赢得比赛并赢得比赛。 但是，以我们想要拥有的那种控球方式来说……是不可能的。 ‘我们在客场丢了很多分，因为我们是不同类型的球员，你看。所以我们遇到了问题。与曼联和阿森纳相比，我们真的不知道如何打反击，他们的设置符合当时英格兰足球的现实。我们有点超前了。”这一点值得我们深思一下。曼联和阿森纳打的是世纪之交英格兰足球特有的快节奏反击比赛，而切尔西的主教练则渴望控制和控球——这种比赛风格与 2020 年代的英超联赛更相关。德塞利将这句话与他在这里的时光联系起来，首先是维亚利，然后是克劳迪奥·拉涅利。然而，在他的蓝军生涯即将结束时，他开始看到一个不同的切尔西正在崛起，一个准备更认真地挑战冠军头衔的切尔西。 “2004年，如果阿森纳没有打出无敌赛季，我们就会赢得胜利，”他说，“因为球员的素质非常高，贝隆、克雷斯波、马克莱莱、格雷米……特里开始达到巅峰，兰帕德也达到巅峰。” “拉涅利干得好。他在西汉姆联队中认出了兰帕德。一开始，我们不太理解，因为他训练得不好。他很聪明，你知道，在训练中尽量减少努力，但在比赛中，哇，多么聪明的中场球员啊！ “至于约翰，我们自然知道他是一位领导者。从一开始，我就看到了他：年轻、新鲜、英国人……准备好了，在零下四、零下五的时候穿着短袖短裤来训练！ “但我想说，我们为建立这个基础感到自豪。我再说一遍，切尔西的胜利心态是从我们开始的，在肯·贝茨决定出售俱乐部后，[罗曼]阿布拉莫维奇进入了体系，这有点幸运。 “那场利物浦比赛……我知道你想谈论它。”他没有错。谁不想与马塞尔·德塞利谈论 2002/03 赛季的最后一场比赛，当时我们遇到利物浦，知道胜利或平局将使我们重返欧洲冠军联赛，而失败将使我们的对手获得该赛事的最后一个席位？更重要的是，在那场比赛之前，人们谈论了俱乐部严峻的财务状况，以及需要获得参加欧洲最大的比赛的资格来获得奖金，这将有助于维持我们作为顶级俱乐部的地位。 “是的，是的，是的，从经济上来说，情况并不好，”德塞利说，“他们正要......是的，这很困难。难的。所以是的，我能感觉到它是独一无二的。好吧，在欧冠联赛中对阵米兰、巴塞罗那的比赛也很独特，但那场利物浦英超比赛真的很紧张。”那天早些时候我们就落后了，但戴着队长袖标的德塞利用头球扳平了比分，不久之后杰斯珀·格隆克贾尔 (Jesper Gronkjaer) 进球，最终成为上半场戏剧性的制胜球。我问打进我们历史上那个关键进球的感觉如何。 “作为队长的责任，你知道吗？”他说。 “我们0-1落后。我无法真正解释为什么我在那里——角球没有被踢，我没有理由在那里！ '责任。让我尝试一些事情，让我继续前进，向我的队友展示我的能力，当然这有帮助，之后，Gronkjaer 做了自己的事情！ ‘是的，我们非常高兴，非常高兴。当你看到切尔西多年来的演变时……我不得不离开（一年后），因为我已经 35 岁了，或者类似的原因。我无法留下来。我还有一年的时间，我去体验了中东足球的氛围，但我把目光投向了切尔西……事实上，他们赢得了联赛冠军。我离开的那一年，他们赢得了联赛冠军！”德塞利确实在 2000 年赢得了足总杯——这是在原来的温布利球场举行的最后一场决赛——但在带领球队走向伟大的边缘后，他错失了俱乐部 50 年来的第一个联赛冠军，这似乎不公平。 “是的，这不公平，”他同意道。 “米兰也发生过这种情况，但那是不同的，因为我已经和他们一起赢得了冠军。在切尔西，这是快乐与痛苦的结合。”无论如何，他的传奇地位在斯坦福桥是稳固的，他是在原来的棚墙上永久展示的标志性球员之一。 在切尔西队长名单上，他的名字正好位于丹尼斯·怀斯和约翰·特里之间，他将自己的做事方式带入了这个角色。 “丹尼斯担任我们的队长已经很长时间了，他是一位历史悠久的球员，有着斗牛犬的心态，所以我们追随他，我们准备为他而死，”德塞利说。 “我以不同的方式成为一名队长，试图通过我最高水平的经验为每个人提供服务。我告诉你，我非常自豪能够担任切尔西队长。哇，哇，哇。 “我想要一些不同的东西，我很高兴我搬到了切尔西。尽管我在米兰踢球，但从足球角度、生活方式角度来说，这对我来说确实是一次很好的转会。对于我的孩子来说能够体验它很重要。即使是现在，我的孩子们仍然感谢我，因为他们在法国学校建立了联系，能够移居到英国这样一个充满活力的国家。能够成为提高现在英超联赛水平的一部分是一件伟大的事情——是的，是的。”这篇采访首先在比赛日节目中发表。您可以在这里购买过去和未来的节目。

news.title: Chelsea's confirmed UEFA Women's Champions League fixture dates
news.title_zh: 切尔西确认了欧洲女子冠军联赛的比赛日期
news.body_en: Chelsea's league phase dates for the next stage of the Women's Champions League have now been confirmed. The Blues were placed in Pot 1 after we qualified for the competition with a 6-2 aggregate win over Real Sociedad. And when Friday's draw took place, we were placed against Paris Saint-Germain, Roma and Austria Vienna at home and OL Lyonnes, BK Hacken and OH Leuven away. All of our Champions League home fixtures will take place at Plough Lane. Our fixtures have now been confirmed and are as follows: 23 September 2026 - Austria Vienna (H) 8pm30 September 2026 - OL Lyonnes (A) 8pm28 October 2026 - AS Roma (H) 5.45pm 10 November 2026 - BK Hacken (A) 5.45pm18 November 2026 - Paris Saint-Germain (H) 8pm 16 December 2026 - OH Leuven (A) 8pm Priority access for Women's Champions League tickets starts on Monday 7 September. Season ticket holders and Bridge Pass holders get first access to UWCL tickets from 2pm. General sale will open 24 hours later, at 2pm on Tuesday 8 September. Don't miss out on early-bird pricing! news.title: Alonso on learning from every game, win or lose
news.title_zh: 阿隆索从每场比赛中学习，无论输赢
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes Sunday’s loss to Arsenal will prove to be an important part of the learning process as his Chelsea team continues to take shape during the early stages of his tenure as manager. The Blues travelled across the capital for a London derby away at title holders Arsenal in our third Premier League fixture under Alonso’s leadership. Morgan Rogers gave us an early lead in a good start at the Emirates Stadium, but the Gunners came back to win 2-1, even if we went close to further goals when Pedro Neto hit the post and Estevao Willian had a late shot tipped over the bar. The Chelsea manager felt we showed we are on the right track by taking the game to last season’s champions and pushing them all the way in their stadium, even if there are still areas where improvement is needed. ‘I want to compete in the best possible way to win,’ explained Alonso after the final whistle at the Emirates Stadium. ‘Yesterday, we didn’t want to from the first minute sit deep and to wait and to make it a long game. We wanted to be active. We wanted to be protagonists in the pressing – sometimes to go higher, sometimes lower – to have good possession. ‘We did many things right, other things we need to make better. We need to learn from them, because this is the top level and when we have to play at the top level we want to be as efficient and as accurate in all the phases of the game as possible. ‘But this is where we are. This is game three for us in this new start, this new phase for Chelsea, but I am happy with the spirit and attitude of the players. They have given everything, they have tried and they fought really hard.’ As Alonso points out, it is still early days for the Blues under our Spanish manager, meaning every game is an opportunity to continue learning and improving. ‘Yesterday’s game, we will take many things for the next one, as we have done so far after Fulham, after Brighton, after Luton. We want to squeeze everything from each game to make things better, when we win and when we lose as well. ‘That is the process of where we are, where we want to build strong principles and strong ideas for our game, little by little, to win games and to compete in the best possible way.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索相信周日输给阿森纳的比赛将被证明是学习过程的重要组成部分，因为他的切尔西队在他担任主教练的早期阶段继续成形。蓝军穿越首都，客场与卫冕冠军阿森纳进行伦敦德比，这是阿隆索带领下的第三场英超比赛。摩根·罗杰斯在酋长球场为我们带来了良好的开局，但枪手最终以 2-1 获胜，尽管当佩德罗·内托击中门柱和埃斯特沃·威廉最后时刻的射门高出横梁时，我们已经接近进一步进球。切尔西主教练认为，我们通过将比赛带到了上赛季的冠军球队并在球场上一路推动他们，表明我们走在正确的轨道上，即使仍然有需要改进的地方。 “我想以最好的方式去比赛并赢得胜利，”阿隆索在酋长球场终场哨响后解释道。 “昨天，我们不想从第一分钟就坐下来等待，让比赛变得漫长。我们想要活跃起来。我们希望成为紧逼中的主角——有时走得更高，有时走得更低——以获得良好的控球权。 “我们做了很多正确的事情，但其他事情我们需要做得更好。我们需要向他们学习，因为这是顶级水平，当我们必须在顶级水平上比赛时，我们希望在比赛的所有阶段都尽可能高效和准确。 ‘但这就是我们现在的处境。这是我们在新的开始、切尔西的新阶段的第三场比赛，但我对球员们的精神和态度感到满意。他们付出了一切，他们已经尝试过，他们真的很努力。”正如阿隆索指出的那样，在我们的西班牙主教练的带领下，蓝军还处于早期阶段，这意味着每场比赛都是继续学习和提高的机会。 `昨天的比赛，我们将为下一场比赛做很多事情，就像我们在富勒姆、布莱顿、卢顿之后所做的那样。我们希望在每场比赛中竭尽全力，让事情变得更好，无论我们赢还是输。 “这就是我们所处的过程，我们希望为我们的游戏一点一点地建立强有力的原则和强有力的想法，以赢得比赛并以尽可能最好的方式竞争。”

news.title: Morgan Rogers: We know we will get even better
news.title_zh: 摩根罗杰斯：我们知道我们会变得更好
news.body_en: Three victories did not convince Morgan Rogers that Chelsea were the finished article. One defeat has not altered his belief in where they are heading. Sunday’s 2-1 loss at Arsenal was the first setback of Xabi Alonso’s tenure, but Rogers’ message remained the same as it would have been had the Blues left north London with another victory. It is still early. There is still work to do. And there is no doubt in the forward’s mind that Chelsea will continue to improve. ‘It’s only the fourth game under him,’ said Rogers. ‘We know we’ve got work to do. Even after the three wins, we knew work was needed, so it doesn’t change. We stay fully focused and move forward. ‘We work hard on the training pitch, trying to understand each other more and how we want to play. We’ll get better. We know we will. ‘We’ll be here again, having the same conversation about improving because we always want to improve and always will get better.’ That conviction has been strengthened by the positive start Alonso has made at Cobham and the speed with which the squad have embraced his ideas. That has been evidenced by the Blues heading into today's London derby off the back of three victories against Fulham, Brighton & Hove Albion and Luton Town in the Carabao Cup. ‘It’s been really good and really positive,’ Rogers continued. ‘You see time and time again that managers come in and struggle at the start when they are adapting, but we have done really well to take the manager’s ideas on board. ‘We have used our quality and the players we have in the changing room. We have done well to win the games we have and with the way we have played. ‘Of course, there are areas to improve because it is really early days. But seeing the positive signs so early and being encouraged constantly, every day on the training pitch and in games, there is only one way we are going – and that is forward. ‘That is all you can ask as a player when there has been a change in the building and you are trying to achieve something.’ That longer-term optimism did not lessen the immediate frustration felt by Rogers and his team-mates at the final whistle in north London. It was Rogers who had put Chelsea in front inside the opening two minutes with his arrowed shot into the bottom corner from the edge of the penalty area. But Kai Havertz pulled a goal back midway thorough the first half and Martin Odegaard's finish early into the second period proved to be enough, despite the Blues going in search of an equaliser, with Estevao Willian in particular bringing the best out of David Raya. ‘We are disappointed,’ he acknowledged. ‘We came here with a job to try to win, and we didn’t manage that, so of course the players and the boys are disappointed. But it’s a long season and it’s a tough place to come. ‘I think we gave a good account of ourselves. We played well in large parts of the game, created chances and defended well when we had to. Of course, it’s tough, and they’re in a really good moment right now and feeling really good. ‘There is still stuff for us to work on. We’re still new, with a new manager, trying to combine our ideas and get better and better. But we will. We know we will. ‘We know we’ve got the quality in the room. It’s just about working hard on the training field and putting things right.’
news.body_zh: 三场胜利并没有让摩根·罗杰斯相信切尔西就是成品。一场失败并没有改变他对球队前进方向的信念。周日以 2-1 输给阿森纳的比赛是哈维·阿隆索任期内的第一次挫折，但罗杰斯的信息仍然相同，就像蓝军带着另一场胜利离开伦敦北部一样。现在还早。还有工作要做。毫无疑问，在这位前锋的心目中，切尔西将继续进步。 “这只是他执教的第四场比赛，”罗杰斯说。 “我们知道我们还有工作要做。即使在三场胜利之后，我们也知道需要努力，所以这一点没有改变。我们保持全神贯注并继续前进。 “我们在训练场上努力训练，试图更多地了解彼此以及我们想要如何比赛。我们会变得更好。我们知道我们会的。 “我们会再次来到这里，进行同样的关于改进的对话，因为我们总是想要改进，并且总是会变得更好。”阿隆索在科巴姆取得的积极开局以及球队接受他的想法的速度增强了这一信念。蓝军在卡拉宝杯中三场战胜富勒姆、布莱顿和卢顿之后进入今天的伦敦德比就证明了这一点。 “这真的很好，也很积极，”罗杰斯继续说道。 “你一次又一次地看到，经理们在适应时一开始就陷入困境，但我们在采纳经理的想法方面做得非常好。 `我们利用了我们的实力和更衣室里的球员。我们以我们的踢球方式做得很好，赢得了比赛。 “当然，还有一些需要改进的地方，因为现在还处于早期阶段。但这么早就看到了积极的迹象，并在每天的训练场和比赛中不断受到鼓励，我们只有一条路可以走——那就是前进。 “当球队发生了变化，并且你正在努力实现某些目标时，作为一名球员，这就是你所能要求的。”这种长期乐观并没有减轻罗杰斯和他的队友在伦敦北部的终场哨声响起时立即感受到的挫败感。正是罗杰斯在开场两分钟内从禁区边缘射入球门底角，帮助切尔西取得领先。但凯·哈弗茨在上半场中段扳回一球，而马丁·厄德高在下半场一开始的射门就证明了足够，尽管蓝军正在寻求扳平比分，尤其是埃斯特沃·威廉，大卫·拉亚发挥出了最好的水平。 “我们很失望，”他承认。 “我们来到这里的目的是为了赢得胜利，但我们没有做到这一点，所以球员和小伙子们当然感到失望。但这是一个漫长的赛季，而且是一个艰难的地方。 “我认为我们对自己的表现很好。我们在比赛的大部分时间里都踢得很好，创造了机会，并且在必要时防守得很好。当然，这很艰难，但他们现在正处于一个非常好的时刻，感觉非常好。 “我们还有很多工作要做。我们还是新人，有一位新经理，正在努力结合我们的想法并变得越来越好。但我们会的。我们知道我们会的。 “我们知道我们房间里的质量很高。这只是在训练场上努力工作并把事情做好。

news.title: Alonso: Arsenal loss needs to hurt in a positive way
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：阿森纳的失利需要以积极的方式伤害
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso was proud of his Chelsea side's fighting spirit against Arsenal and hopes the pain of defeat will fuel the Blues as the season progresses. We acquitted ourselves well at the Emirates Stadium, going toe-to-toe with the Premier League title holders and taking an early lead when Morgan Rogers fired home a fine volley inside the first two minutes. Arsenal fought back to take the lead themselves after half-time, but Chelsea pushed the Gunners all the way, with Pedro Neto striking the post and Estevao Willian being spectacularly denied by goalkeeper David Raya late on. As he assessed the game after the final whistle, Alonso insisted that as disappointing as any defeat is, he was proud of the battling qualities shown by his team in this London derby. ‘It was a game with different stages of momentum,' said the Blues manager. 'We started the game well, scoring first, and the next 15 minutes they were really pushing us hard. We were defending low, struggling to have a little bit more of the ball to play a little bit more on the pitch. ‘So those 15 minutes were hard and we had to suffer. Once we conceded the goal for 1-1, the game came back to an even level for them and from us. We had a couple of good chances before the end of the first half, but at half-time we spoke. 'It was a very close game, very intense, when we had to have really high levels of concentration, not to give many advantages to them to be in the game, to be fighting for it. 'For sure, the second goal, we could’ve done a little bit better. It’s a part of the game you need to accept because they are a top side and they push you to the limits. They overload a lot on the left side with many players and they got the goal with Odegaard. 'But after that we have kept going and the team showed really good desire and good spirit to fight until the end. We were close with the chance from Este. 'It’s a defeat and we are disappointed; it needs to hurt, but it needs to hurt in a positive way because it’s just game three [of the season]. There are still many games to play and we knew it was going to be a very intense game today.' The Spaniard was also asked after the game if there were any new concerns over Moises Caicedo missing the trip to Arsenal - having been forced off on his return from injury against Brighton & Hove Albion last week - as well as what impact being without the Ecuadorian and Levi Colwill had on Sunday's game. 'It is not long-term [for Caicedo] but it’s about assessing the risk,' added Alonso. 'Probably, last week, we took him too early and I don’t want to make the same mistake again. 'It’s easy after defeats to talk about the players that you are missing. I’m not going to go there, I am happy with the players that we have. 'For sure, all the managers need to deal with injuries, with suspensions. To have all the players available for all the games is impossible. But we need [Caicedo and Colwill] because they are top players and with them we are a better team.'
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索为他的切尔西队对阵阿森纳的战斗精神感到自豪，并希望随着赛季的进展，失败的痛苦能够为蓝军注入动力。我们在酋长球场表现出色，与英超卫冕冠军正面交锋，摩根·罗杰斯在前两分钟内打出漂亮的凌空抽射，我们早早取得领先。半场结束后，阿森纳奋力反击，取得领先，但切尔西一路逼近枪手，佩德罗·内托击中门柱，埃斯特沃·威廉在最后时刻被门将大卫·拉亚精彩挡出。在终场哨响后评估比赛时，阿隆索坚持认为，尽管任何失败都令人失望，但他对他的球队在这场伦敦德比中表现出的战斗能力感到自豪。 “这是一场不同阶段的比赛，”蓝军主教练说道。 “我们的比赛开局很好，首先进球，接下来的 15 分钟他们真的给我们施加了压力。我们防守低位，努力争取更多的控球权，以便在球场上发挥更多的作用。 “所以那 15 分钟很艰难，我们不得不受苦。当我们1-1丢球后，比赛对我们和他们来说又回到了平局。上半场结束前我们有过几次很好的机会，但到了半场我们就开始说话了。 “这是一场非常胶着的比赛，非常激烈，我们必须高度集中注意力，不给他们太多优势，让他们参与比赛，为比赛而战。” “当然，第二个进球我们可以做得更好一点。这是你需要接受的比赛的一部分，因为他们是顶级球队，他们将你推向极限。他们在左路人满为患，有很多球员，厄德高进球了。 “但在那之后我们继续前进，球队表现出了非常好的愿望和战斗到最后的精神。我们距离埃斯特的机会很近。 “这是一场失败，我们很失望；它需要受到伤害，但它需要以积极的方式受到伤害，因为这只是[本赛季]的第三场比赛。还有很多比赛要打，我们知道今天这将是一场非常激烈的比赛。”赛后西班牙人还被问及莫伊塞斯·凯塞多错过阿森纳之旅是否有任何新的担忧——上周对阵布莱顿的比赛中伤愈复出后被迫下场——以及厄瓜多尔人和列维·科尔威尔的缺席对周日的比赛有何影响。阿隆索补充道，“（对凯塞多来说）这不是长期目标，而是评估风险。” “可能上周我们把他带走得太早了，我不想再犯同样的错误。 “在失利后很容易谈论你错过的球员。我不会去那里，我对我们拥有的球员感到满意。 “当然，所有主帅都需要应对伤病和停赛问题。让所有球员都能参加所有比赛是不可能的。但我们需要[凯塞多和科尔威尔]，因为他们是顶级球员，有了他们，我们就会成为一支更好的球队。”

news.title: Match report: Arsenal 2-1 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：阿森纳 2-1 切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea succumbed to a narrow defeat away at Premier League title holders Arsenal, despite the Blues taking another early lead at the Emirates Stadium. The Blues were eyeing a memorable afternoon in north London as we looked to end our derby rivals' 100 per cent record this season with a statement Premier League victory. We took a step towards that becoming reality when Morgan Rogers caught everyone out with a clever first-time shot from outside the box that wrong-footed goalkeeper David Raya on its way into the left-hand corner. Unfortunately, we couldn't hold that advantage, as Arsenal levelled before half-time through Kai Havertz. Martin Odegaard then broke free in the penalty area to give the home side a 2-1 lead shortly after the break. Chelsea refused to lie down and fought hard to salvage a share of the points, and were only denied it by a matter of inches after Pedro Neto hit the post and David Raya tipped an Estevao Willian shot over the bar, but it wasn't to be. Emi Martinez continued between the posts against the club that first brought him to England, but there was a change to the shape ahead of him. Josh Acheampong came in at right-back - Levi Colwill making way - French duo Wesley Fofana and Maxence Lacroix were in the middle, with Jorrel Hato dropping deeper at left-back. Reece James came in for Malo Gusto in midfield with Romeo Lavia, as Pedro Neto pushed higher on the right to join Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers in supporting striker Joao Pedro. There was a big atmosphere inside the Emirates Stadium come kick-off, as you would expect for a London derby between two teams who went into this game with 100 per cent records this season, both sets of supporters eagerly anticipating a massive Sunday afternoon Premier League fixture. Chelsea have made early goals a theme of our season so far, and it was another flying start from the Blues as we opened the scoring inside two minutes. It all stemmed from a free-kick, lofted into the Arsenal box by James and won in the air by Lacroix. It broke loose, but the Gunners failed to clear and Hato kept it alive – his header bouncing invitingly towards Rogers on the edge of the area. The England international didn’t need a second invitation, sweeping a first-time shot low and into the bottom corner, beyond the dive of Raya. The Blues were 1-0 up, but the job was far from done as the Gunners tried to hit back immediately. A free-kick of their own out wide was delivered low and caused chaos in a six-yard box scramble. Martinez was brave to save low and then delve into the tangle of limbs to put the ball out of danger, taking a boot to the head from Gabriel Magalhaes in the process. Dead-ball situations seemed to be the order of the day and Arsenal thought they had levelled the scores when another low free-kick came into the Chelsea box and caused chaos. In a frantic scramble, Martinez initially saved from Ezri Konsa, only for Gabriel’s follow-up to hit the post and squirm back across his goal out of reach, where Riccardo Calafiori was able to score from close range. However, VAR intervened with Konsa offside. Our lead was retained. We were having to work hard to keep it that way, as the home side pushed upfield and Martinez had to save from Havertz and Bukayo Saka, although neither effort really troubled him at his near post. Palmer and James tested Raya with efforts from outside the box, but Chelsea attacks were rare midway through the first half, as Arsenal tried to get back on level terms before the break. There was some stern defending, and one brilliant challenge by Hato in particular, as we tried to prevent them from doing so. Unfortunately, it wouldn’t last. The pressure eventually told when Havertz cut in from the right onto his left foot and found a yard to roll a shot inside Martinez’s near post from the edge of the box. All square again at the Emirates Stadium. The first half ended in something of a stalemate, with neither team able to turn spells of possession into serious pressure, although Neto did come close when he struck the base of the left-hand post with a low shot on the counter in stoppage time. As it was, both teams came out for the second half looking determined to break the deadlock and secure all three points. Despite plenty of fight by the Blues, it was Arsenal who found the next goal and took the lead when Havertz dummied to let a low cross run past him to Odegaard, who had the time and space to finish at close range. Chelsea refused to give in, with Palmer looking for opportunities to get on the attack quickly, although we also needed to guard against Arsenal counter-attacks now. Xabi Alonso turned to his bench in an attempt to give us more control and move the game into the home team's half; Malo Gusto and Pep Chavarria came on in place of Hato and Lavia. The same pattern continued. Palmer and Joao Pedro were looking lively and carrying our biggest threat, but Martinez had to be quick off his line to prevent Arsenal breakaways on a couple of occasions, and produced one brilliant reaction save to deny Saka as we pushed upfield and risked leaving our keeper exposed. Chelsea continued to increase the pressure and had the title holders pinned back in their own half for much of the final 15 minutes. Despite that pressure, plus the introduction of Estevao Willian and Danny Welbeck to bolster our attack, there was just no way through the Arsenal defence. Our winning start to the season was over - despite Estevao forcing a late fingertip save from Raya - but there were still positives for Xabi Alonso to take away from the Emirates, after we pushed the champions all the way on their own turf. Despite dropping points for the first time this season, Chelsea remain fourth in the Premier League table at this early stage in the campaign, three behind joint-leaders Arsenal and Manchester City, who have the last remaining 100 per cent records. Chelsea are back in action in midweek in the first of two games at Stamford Bridge in the coming days. That will be in the Carabao Cup when we host Leeds United in the third round, with kick-off at 8pm on Wednesday 9 September, before Hull City come to SW6 in the Premier League at 3pm on Saturday 12 September. news.body_zh: 尽管蓝军在酋长球场早早取得领先，但切尔西还是在客场险胜英超卫冕冠军阿森纳。蓝军期待着在伦敦北部度过一个难忘的下午，我们希望以一场英超联赛的胜利来结束德比对手本赛季 100% 的战绩。当摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）在禁区外第一次巧妙射门时，我们向这成为现实迈出了一步，门将大卫·拉亚（David Raya）在进入左侧角球时脚错了。不幸的是，我们没能保持住这一优势，阿森纳在半场结束前通过凯·哈弗茨扳平了比分。中场休息后不久，马丁·厄德高在禁区内破门，主队2-1领先。切尔西拒绝躺下，努力拼搏以挽救部分积分，但在佩德罗·内托击中门柱和大卫·拉亚将埃斯特沃·威廉的射门高出横梁后，切尔西只被挡出几英寸，但事实并非如此。埃米·马丁内斯继续在对阵最初将他带到英格兰的俱乐部的比赛中担任门柱，但他前面的形状发生了变化。乔什·阿奇姆蓬（Josh Acheampong）出任右后卫，列维·科尔威尔（Levi Colwill）让路，法国二人组韦斯利·福法纳（Wesley Fofana）和马克斯森斯·拉克鲁瓦（Maxence Lacroix）位于中间，乔雷尔·哈托（Jorrel Hato）在左后卫位置更深。里斯·詹姆斯与罗密欧·拉维亚一起在中场替换马洛·古斯托，佩德罗·内托在右路推高，与科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯一起支援前锋若昂·佩德罗。酋长球场内气氛热烈，正如你所期望的那样，两支球队本赛季以 100% 的战绩进入这场比赛，两支球队之间将有一场伦敦德比，两支球队的支持者都热切地期待周日下午的英超联赛。到目前为止，切尔西已经将早期进球作为我们赛季的主题，这是蓝军的又一次良好开局，我们在两分钟内就取得了进球。这一切都源于一记任意球，詹姆斯将球射入阿森纳禁区，并由拉克鲁瓦在空中获胜。球破门了，但枪手未能解围，哈托将球保住了——他的头球诱人地弹向禁区边缘的罗杰斯。这位英格兰国脚不需要第二次邀请，他第一次低射，射入底角，超出了拉亚的俯冲。蓝军1-0领先，但任务还远未完成，枪手试图立即反击。他们自己的一脚任意球踢得很低，在六码的禁区争夺中造成了混乱。马丁内斯勇敢地低位扑救，然后钻进纠缠的肢体中，使球脱离了危险，在此过程中，加布里埃尔·马加哈斯用一脚踢到了他的头部。死球情况似乎已成为家常便饭，阿森纳以为他们已经扳平了比分，但切尔西禁区内的另一脚低位任意球却造成了混乱。在一场疯狂的争抢中，马丁内斯最初扑出了埃兹里·孔萨的球，但加布里埃尔的跟进击中了门柱，然后蠕动着越过球门，超出了他的射门范围，而里卡多·卡拉菲奥里则近距离射门得分。然而，VAR介入认为孔萨越位。我们的领先优势得以保留。我们必须努力保持这种状态，因为主队向前推进，马丁内斯不得不从哈弗茨和布卡约萨卡身上扑救，尽管这两种努力都没有真正困扰他在近门柱的情况。帕尔默和詹姆斯在禁区外的努力考验了拉亚，但切尔西的进攻在上半场中段很少见，阿森纳试图在中场休息前扳平比分。当我们试图阻止他们这样做时，他们进行了一些严厉的防守，尤其是哈托的一次精彩挑战。不幸的是，它不会持续下去。最终，当哈弗茨从右路切入左脚，找到一码距离将射门从禁区边缘射入马丁内斯的近门柱时，压力最终显现出来。酋长球场再次齐聚。上半场双方陷入了僵局，两支球队都无法将控球权转化为巨大的压力，尽管内托在补时阶段的反击中一脚低射击中左侧门柱底部，但确实接近了。事实上，下半场两队都决心打破僵局并全取三分。尽管蓝军进行了激烈的战斗，但阿森纳找到了下一个进球并取得了领先，哈弗茨假动作让一个低传球越过了他，传给了厄德高，厄德高有时间和空间近距离射门。 切尔西不肯屈服，帕尔默寻找机会快速发起进攻，尽管我们现在也需要防范阿森纳的反击。哈维·阿隆索转向替补席，试图给我们更多的控制权，并将比赛转移到主队半场；马洛·古斯托和佩普·查瓦里亚替换哈托和拉维亚上场。同样的模式仍在继续。帕尔默和若昂·佩德罗看起来很活跃，对我们构成了最大的威胁，但马丁内斯必须迅速离开防线，以防止阿森纳多次突破，并在我们向前推进并冒着让我们的门将暴露的危险时做出了一次精彩的扑救，挡住了萨卡的射门。切尔西继续加大压力，在最后 15 分钟的大部分时间里，卫冕冠军都被困在自己的半场。尽管有这样的压力，再加上引进埃斯特沃·威廉和丹尼·维尔贝克来加强我们的进攻，我们还是无法突破阿森纳的防守。我们本赛季的胜利开局已经结束——尽管埃斯特沃在最后时刻逼迫拉亚做出了指尖扑救——但在我们在冠军自己的地盘上一路推动冠军之后，哈维·阿隆索在酋长球场上仍然有积极的一面。尽管本赛季首次丢分，但切尔西在赛季初期仍排在英超积分榜第四位，落后并列领头羊阿森纳和曼城三分，后者保持着最后的 news.title: Xabi Alonso on Levi Colwill change and Moises Caicedo absence against Arsenal
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索谈列维·科尔威尔的改变和莫伊塞斯·凯塞多缺席对阵阿森纳的比赛
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso says no risks have been taken over Moises Caicedo and Levi Colwill's fitness, with the former not included in the squad to face Arsenal and the latter named among the substitutes. Our third Premier League fixture of the campaign takes us across London to the Emirates Stadium and Alonso has made two alterations to the side that started last weekend’s win over Brighton & Hove Albion. One of those is in defence, with Josh Acheampong replacing Colwill in the back line, while Reece James steps into midfield in place of Malo Gusto. When asked in his pre-match media interview why the change in defence had been made, Alonso replied: ‘Fitness. Levi had a little thing during the week, so we wanted not to take a risk at this stage of the season.’ On Caicedo's absence from the matchday squad, the Blues manager added: ‘He was close but, as well, there is no point in taking too many risks at this moment. Maybe we went too early against Brighton [with his return], so we need to be cautious.’ The Blues have made a strong start to the campaign, with back-to-back victories recorded in the top flight. Arsenal, who won the title last season, have the same record after two matches and Alonso accepts today's contest will be a good test for his developing side. He said: 'We will see how it goes, but for sure, it’s game three for us in this new project that we are starting and we want to have a great game today.'
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索表示，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多和列维·科尔威尔的健康状况没有受到影响，前者没有入选对阵阿森纳的大名单，而后者则被列入替补名单。我们本赛季的第三场英超比赛将穿越伦敦前往酋长球场，阿隆索对上周末战胜布莱顿的首发阵容进行了两次调整。其中之一是后防线，乔什·阿奇姆蓬 (Josh Acheampong) 取代科尔威尔 (Colwill) 出任后防线，而里斯·詹姆斯 (Reece James) 则取代马洛·古斯托 (Malo Gusto) 进入中场。当在赛前媒体采访中被问及为什么要改变防守时，阿隆索回答说：“健身。”列维在本周遇到了一些小事情，所以我们不想在赛季的这个阶段冒险。” 关于凯塞多缺席比赛日阵容，蓝军主教练补充道：“他很接近，但此时此刻没有必要冒太多风险。也许我们（随着他的回归）对阵布莱顿的比赛太早了，所以我们需要谨慎。”蓝军在本赛季取得了强劲的开局，在顶级联赛中取得了背靠背的胜利。上赛季夺得冠军的阿森纳在两场比赛后保持同样的战绩，阿隆索承认今天的比赛将是对他的发展中球队的一次很好的考验。他说：“我们会看看事情进展如何，但可以肯定的是，这对我们来说是这个新项目的第三场比赛，我们正在开始，我们希望今天有一场精彩的比赛。”

news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has made two changes to his Chelsea starting line-up for today’s London derby at Arsenal, with our captain returning to the side. The Blues have a 100 per cent record so far this season, but face arguably our toughest test yet this afternoon, with a trip to the reigning Premier League champions Arsenal. Emi Martinez continues between the posts against the club that first brought him to England, but there is a change to the defence ahead of him. Josh Acheampong comes back into the team alongside French duo Wesley Fofana and Maxence Lacroix. Levi Colwill is among the substitutes for this game. There is another change in midfield, as our skipper Reece James comes in for Malo Gusto. The captain is expected to line up in the centre with Romeo Lavia, while Pedro Neto and Jorrel Hato continue on the flanks. It is an unchanged front three for Chelsea, after Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers and Joao Pedro’s flying start to the campaign. Geovany Quenda returns among the substitutes after missing the win over Brighton & Hove Albion, but the Blues are without Moises Caicedo at the Emirates Stadium. Arsenal have made one change from the team which won 1-0 at Aston Villa in their last match, as England defender Ezri Konsa replaces Cristhian Mosquera. Former Chelsea man Kai Havertz starts up front for the Gunners, with Noni Madueke on their bench. Chelsea: Martinez, Acheampong, Fofana, Lacroix, Neto, James (c), Lavia, Hato, Palmer, Rogers, Joao Pedro Substitutes: Penders, Colwill, Chavarria, Gusto, Barco, Estevao, Gittens, Quenda, Welbeck Arsenal: Raya, White, Konsa, Gabriel, Calafiori, Lewis-Skelly, Rice, Saka, Odegaard (c), Tzolis, Havertz Substitutes: Kepa, Hincapie, Dowman, Guimaraes, Merino, Zubimendi, Eze, Madueke, Gyokeres

news.title: Arsenal vs Chelsea: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 阿森纳 vs 切尔西：你需要知道的一切
news.body_en: Fourth-placed Chelsea make the short trip north to Emirates Stadium to face an Arsenal team in second place as they defend their first Premier League title in 21 years. Sunday’s kick-off is 4.30pm local time, and a first win there since August 2021 would maintain the west Londoners’ 100 per cent start under Xabi Alonso. The close of the transfer window means the dreamtime is over and every club has the squad that must serve them for the next four months. The first test sees the metropolis’ most successful clubs meet for Chelsea’s second London derby of the season and Arsenal’s first. It hands Morgan Rogers an early chance to validate his preference for the blue half of the capital – he has never previously scored against this weekend’s hosts. This is also the period when the football week starts to fill up – though with no European fixtures, the world champions only have Wednesday’s Carabao Cup visit by Leeds in the midweek calendar. Arsenal’s latest attempt to win the Champions League – a trophy that has so far eluded them – starts at Napoli’s Maradona Stadium on Wednesday. Blues manager Xabi Alonso would love a repeat of his first encounter with the Gunners on his 23rd birthday in November 2004 – a 2-1 victory in which he banged in the opener. Ten years ago a new boss took his promising Chelsea side to Emirates early in the Premier League season. The first half was a write-off as the Blues shipped three without reply, but a tactical switch after the break became a sliding-doors moment. Antonio Conte’s change to a three-man backline led to a thrilling campaign that eventually brought the national title back to west London. That was also one of six seasons when the Blues won away to the defending champions of the Premier League – a 3-0 victory at Claudio Ranieri’s Leicester with Marcos Alonso accounting for two and Pedro the other. The Londoners had done the same against the Premier League’s maiden winners, Manchester Utd – and repeated the feat several times since. Shortly before the 1994 FA Cup final, a Gavin Peacock finish was enough to end United’s 34-game unbeaten home run. Three seasons later, the same opponents were beaten at Old Trafford, with a Michael Duberry header and Luca Vialli’s nutmeg contributing to a 2-1 success. And in December 2001, the Londoners’ dominant display earned a 3-0 victory at United – Mario Melchiot, Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink and Eidur Gudjohnsen finding the net. In April 2010, champions and hosts United were again 2-1 victims – this time Joe Cole and Didier Drogba doing the damage for Carlo Ancelotti’s future title winners. And most recently, in March 2021, Mason Mount’s only goal at Anfield helped topple Liverpool’s crown. Chelsea are aiming to open the season with four successive victories on all fronts for the first time since our title-winning 2016/17 season. With 49 goals from 98 Premier League games, Cole Palmer is one off a half-century – Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink (84) and Diego Costa (85) are the only Blues players to have reached 50 in fewer than 100 matches. Arsenal’s run of nine unbeaten against the Blues in the Premier League is their best since 1995-2005. Xabi Alonso and Mikel Arteta are two of the four current Premier League managers who hail from the Basque region of Spain. (The others are Unai Emery and Andoni Iraola.) The last time Arsenal beat Man City 3-0 in the Community Shield was 2014 – but it was Chelsea who went on to win the Premier League. Chelsea have generated 1.9 or more expected goals before half-time in both league matches to date. The world champions claimed just 26 per cent of possession during last weekend’s 4-3 beating of Brighton – but 53 per cent of total shots (17/32). Joao Pedro has scored and set up goals in both opening league fixtures this season – the first player in the club’s history to do so. Morgan Rogers has created nine chances for team-mates so far this season – the most in the Premier League and the highest total by any Blues player in his first two appearances on record (since 2003/04). Sunday’s match was the 28th we have won 4-3 and the 11th in the Premier League era. Between 9 April 1960 and 4 September 1965, Chelsea won all six league visits to Arsenal’s former ground, Highbury, scoring three or more each time – 4-1, 4-1, 3-0, 4-2, 3-1 and 3-1.
news.body_zh: 排名第四的切尔西将向北前往酋长球场，迎战排名第二的阿森纳队，卫冕 21 年来的首个英超冠军。周日的开球时间为当地时间下午 4.30，自 2021 年 8 月以来的首次胜利将使西伦敦人在哈维·阿隆索的带领下保持 100% 的开局。转会窗口的关闭意味着梦想时光结束，每个俱乐部都有必须在接下来的四个月里为他们服务的阵容。第一场考验是伦敦最成功的俱乐部将迎来切尔西本赛季的第二场伦敦德比，也是阿森纳的首场伦敦德比。这为摩根·罗杰斯提供了一个尽早验证他对首都蓝色一半的偏好的机会——他此前从未在对阵本周末东道主的比赛中进球。这也是足球周开始排满的时期——尽管没有欧洲比赛，世界冠军队在周中只有周三利兹联队来访的卡拉宝杯。阿森纳最近一次试图赢得欧洲冠军联赛——这是他们迄今为止未能获得的奖杯——将于周三在那不勒斯的马拉多纳体育场开始。蓝军主教练哈比·阿隆索希望能够重演他在 2004 年 11 月 23 岁生日那天与枪手的第一次交锋——他在首场比赛中以 2-1 取得胜利。十年前，一位新主帅在英超赛季初期将他前途光明的切尔西队带到了酋长球场。上半场蓝军三分未有回应，结果被淘汰，但中场休息后的战术转变变成了一个滑门时刻。安东尼奥·孔蒂对三人后卫的改变带来了一场激动人心的战役，最终将全国冠军带回伦敦西部。这也是蓝军客场战胜英超卫冕冠军的六个赛季之一——3-0战胜克劳迪奥·拉涅利的莱斯特城，马科斯·阿隆索占两席，佩德罗占另一席。伦敦人在对阵英超首个冠军曼联的比赛中也做了同样的事情，并且此后多次重复了这一壮举。 1994 年足总杯决赛前不久，加文·皮科克 (Gavin Peacock) 的射门足以终结曼联 34 场不败的本垒打。三个赛季后，同样的对手在老特拉福德被击败，迈克尔·杜伯里的头球和卢卡·维亚利的肉豆蔻球帮助球队2-1获胜。 2001 年 12 月，伦敦人以 3-0 的统治力战胜了曼联——马里奥·梅尔奇奥特、吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克和埃杜尔·古德约翰森分别进球。 2010年4月，冠军和东道主曼联再次以2-1惨败——这一次乔·科尔和迪迪埃·德罗巴为卡洛·安切洛蒂未来的冠军得主造成了损害。最近，2021 年 3 月，梅森·芒特在安菲尔德打进的唯一进球帮助利物浦推翻了桂冠。切尔西的目标是自 2016/17 赛季夺冠以来首次在各条战线上取得四连胜。科尔·帕尔默在 98 场英超比赛中攻入 49 粒进球，堪称半个世纪以来进球数最多的球员——吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克（84 球）和迭戈·科斯塔（85 球）是唯一两位在不到 100 场比赛中打入 50 粒进球的蓝军球员。阿森纳在英超联赛中对阵蓝军的九场不败是他们自1995-2005年以来的最好成绩。哈维·阿隆索和米克尔·阿尔特塔是来自西班牙巴斯克地区的四位现任英超主教练中的两位。 （其他人是乌奈·埃梅里和安多尼·伊劳拉。）阿森纳上一次在社区盾杯中以 3-0 击败曼城是在 2014 年，但最终赢得英超冠军的是切尔西。迄今为止，切尔西在两场联赛的半场结束前均取得了 1.9 个或更多的预期进球。在上周末 4-3 击败布莱顿的比赛中，世界冠军队仅占据 26% 的控球率，但占总射门数的 53%（17/32）。若昂·佩德罗在本赛季的两场联赛首场比赛中均取得进球并助攻——他是俱乐部历史上第一位做到这一点的球员。本赛季到目前为止，摩根·罗杰斯已经为队友创造了九次机会——这是英超联赛中最多的，也是蓝军球员有记录的前两次出场中创造机会最多的球员（自2003/04赛季以来）。周日的比赛是我们以4-3获胜的第28场比赛，也是英超时代的第11场比赛。 1960年4月9日至1965年9月4日期间，切尔西在联赛中对阿森纳的前主场海布里进行了全部六次联赛访问，每次都取得了三个或更多进球——4-1、4-1、3-0、4-2、3-1和3-1。
